description: Email validation and verification before sending: is this address likely deliverable? Checks syntax, the domain's mail servers (MX), SPF and DMARC, role addresses (info@, sales@) and disposable email providers, and returns a verdict with reasons. Never contacts the mailbox. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402). Free sample: call free_sample with tool="email_check".
